Leave me, O love! which reachest but to dust! / And thou, my mind! aspire to higher things! / Grow rich in that, which never taketh rust! / Whatever fades, but fading pleasure brings.

—
Sonnet XXXIV
, ll 1–4.

Sir Philip

Sidney
